items.title: LosaLosSantos/aurelio-finance
items.excerpt: Open-source personal finance app with an AI financial advisor: track your net worth, investments, ETFs, cash and debts on your own computer.
items.summary: LosaLosSantos describes an open-source personal finance app with AI advisor that tracks net worth, investments, ETFs, cash and debts locally on your computer.
items.usefulness: If the AI advisor component is functional, could help prototype document analysis and structured financial data extraction for Python tool development.
items.to_verify: Whether the AI advisor actually analyzes financial documents or only displays manually entered data; what documents it accepts.

items.title: Sub-1-Bit LLM Compression via Latent Factorization
items.summary: SamsungLabs published LittleBit, a GitHub repository on sub-1-bit LLM compression via latent factorization, attracting 86 HN points.
items.usefulness: Could inform Python tool design if compression reduces model size enough to enable local document analysis without external API calls.
items.to_verify: The actual compression ratio achieved, inference speed tradeoff, and whether compressed models retain accuracy on document tasks.
